title: Amazon Research Awards — Agentic AI (Fall 2026)
description: Supports innovative work on agentic AI, autonomous agents and related research. The Fall 2026 call has multiple focus areas; check the program page for the exact rules and application requirements.
eligibility: Research proposals from eligible academic principal investigators; institutional gift arrangement. Check the specific call and FAQs for PI rules.

title: OpenAI Researcher Access Program
description: Subsidized API access for research on responsible AI deployment, risk mitigation, human-AI interaction and societal impacts. Applications are reviewed quarterly.
eligibility: Affiliation with an academic or research organization or an eligible nonprofit, in an API-supported country. Early-stage researchers are encouraged.

title: NVIDIA Academic Grant Program
description: Academic research support for AI training, inference, agents, systems software, simulation and modeling. The program currently reports that new applications are not being accepted.
eligibility: Full-time faculty member at an accredited research-degree-granting institution; other topic-specific requirements may apply.

title: Google Academic Research Awards — Quantum Computing (2026)
description: Google's 2026 Academic Research Awards call focused on early fault-tolerant quantum algorithms and quantum-computing security. The 2026 application window has closed.
eligibility: Professors at eligible degree-granting institutions who advise students and conduct relevant research. Postdocs may be permitted as co-PIs under certain conditions.

title: Google Cloud for Researchers — Research Credits
description: Research support through Google Cloud credits and resources; the amount, submission availability and program-specific eligibility should be checked on the official page.
eligibility: Google lists faculty, postdoctoral researchers, nonprofit lab researchers and PhD students as eligible to apply for research award credits; check the current offering.

title: Wellcome Early-Career Awards
amount: Salary and research expenses, subject to scheme rules
description: Funding for early-career researchers developing an independent research identity through projects relating to human life, health and wellbeing. Applications can be submitted at any time under the current scheme.
eligibility: Career-stage, host-organization and location rules apply. Check Wellcome's detailed eligibility criteria before applying.

title: Wellcome Discovery Awards
description: Funding for established researchers and teams pursuing ambitious research advancing understanding of human life, health and wellbeing. Wellcome lists the scheme as accepting applications anytime.
eligibility: Typically for established researchers leading ambitious programs. Confirm location and organizational requirements.

title: Microsoft Research Fellowship
description: Official research-support program covering artificial intelligence, computer science, machine learning. Current application windows, support type and applicant requirements must be checked on the program page.
eligibility: Program source identified; current calls, applicant roles, institutional sponsorship and geography must be checked on the official page.

title: Sony Research Award Program — 2026
description: Supports university research in Sony’s general and focused research areas.
eligibility: University faculty at eligible institutions in the U.S., Canada, India and selected European countries. Check the submission guidelines for institution and PI requirements.

title: Cisco Research Funding
description: Cisco supports academic research through gifts tied to specific requests for proposals.
eligibility: Full-time faculty or research staff at eligible universities or nonprofits may be PIs. Students can join the research team.

title: AWS Cloud Credit for Research
description: Official research-support program covering cloud computing, artificial intelligence, biomedical research. Current application windows, support type and applicant requirements must be checked on the program page.
eligibility: Program source identified; current calls, applicant roles, institutional sponsorship and geography must be checked on the official page.

title: Samsung Global Research Outreach
description: Official research-support program covering semiconductors, materials, artificial intelligence, engineering. Current application windows, support type and applicant requirements must be checked on the program page.
eligibility: Program source identified; current calls, applicant roles, institutional sponsorship and geography must be checked on the official page.

title: Adobe India AI Research Fellowship
description: Supports PhD research in artificial intelligence. The sponsor lists 2026 recipients; confirm the next application window.
eligibility: Full-time PhD candidates at recognized Indian universities with at least 12 months remaining in their program.

title: Varian / Siemens Healthineers Investigator-Initiated Research
description: Official research-support program covering medical physics, radiotherapy, radiation oncology, treatment planning. Current application windows, support type and applicant requirements must be checked on the program page.
eligibility: Program source identified; current calls, applicant roles, institutional sponsorship and geography must be checked on the official page.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Ask the sponsor whether the proposed research topic is in scope and confirm who can submit for your institution.

title: Elekta Investigator-Initiated Research
description: Official research-support program covering medical physics, radiotherapy, radiation oncology, treatment planning. Current application windows, support type and applicant requirements must be checked on the program page.
eligibility: Program source identified; current calls, applicant roles, institutional sponsorship and geography must be checked on the official page.

title: Pfizer Investigator Sponsored Research
description: Official research-support program covering oncology, medical research, clinical research, biomedical research. Current application windows, support type and applicant requirements must be checked on the program page.
eligibility: Program source identified; current calls, applicant roles, institutional sponsorship and geography must be checked on the official page.

title: Merck Investigator Studies Program
description: Official research-support program covering oncology, medical research, clinical research. Current application windows, support type and applicant requirements must be checked on the program page.
eligibility: Program source identified; current calls, applicant roles, institutional sponsorship and geography must be checked on the official page.

title: 2027 AAPM Research Seed Funding Grant
description: Early-career medical-physics research support. Published deadlines: mandatory letter of intent March 22, 2027; full application April 19, 2027, both 11:59 PM ET. Confirm current submission availability.
eligibility: AAPM membership required. PI eligibility, career timing, rank, funding history and concurrent-submission restrictions apply; postdocs/research scientists need a mentor.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Confirm PI privileges before the March 22 letter of intent. Do not also apply to the Global Health or ASTRO–AAPM seed grant.

title: ASTRO-AAPM Physics Residents / Postdoctoral Fellows Seed Grant
description: Joint seed program for radiation-oncology physics research. ASTRO currently lists this opportunity under past funding with a closed deadline.
eligibility: For relevant medical-physics residents and postdoctoral fellows; verify the next call and detailed applicant rules. Society affiliation alone does not establish eligibility.

title: ASTRO Residents/Fellows in Radiation Oncology Seed Grant
description: Trainee research seed program in radiation oncology. The official ASTRO directory currently labels the deadline closed.
eligibility: The listed program requires enrollment in a U.S. residency or fellowship at application; check any future round and all criteria.

title: Sigma Xi Grants in Aid of Research
description: Student research grants across scientific fields. Recurring deadlines are March 15 and October 1; verify the applicable round and application window.
eligibility: For enrolled undergraduate and graduate degree-seeking students. Membership is not required; student or advisor membership can affect designated funds. Postdoc or resident status alone is not qualifying enrollment.

title: Stanford Bio-X Interdisciplinary Initiatives Seed Grants
description: Interdisciplinary seed program for early-stage collaborative research in biosciences, bioengineering and biomedicine. Current page describes past awards; no new open round is inferred.
eligibility: Faculty-team program at Stanford. Confirm current call and appointment/collaboration requirements; prior Stanford education alone is insufficient.

title: IEEE Photonics Society Graduate Student Scholarship
description: Graduate research scholarship in photonics. Confirm the applicable cycle and current submission dates on the official program page.
eligibility: Requires active IEEE Photonics Society student membership and graduate study in the relevant field; general IEEE membership alone is not sufficient. Check study-year and other current requirements.

title: NEH Fellowships — 2027
description: Supports sustained humanities research and writing by individual scholars.
eligibility: Individual scholars apply. Check citizenship or residency requirements and the 2027 notice’s research scope.

title: Mathematical Sciences Postdoctoral Research Fellowships
description: Supports postdoctoral work in mathematics and statistics through research or combined research and teaching fellowships.
eligibility: For recent mathematics or statistics PhDs who meet U.S. citizenship, national or permanent residency and doctorate timing requirements.

title: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowships
description: Funds research and training abroad through European and Global Postdoctoral Fellowships across disciplines.
eligibility: Apply with a host. A doctorate, research experience limits and mobility rules apply; nationality rules differ between tracks.

title: NIH Pathway to Independence Award (K99/R00) — no independent trial
description: Supports a mentored research phase and transition to an independent research position. This notice excludes independent clinical trials.
eligibility: For eligible mentored postdoctoral researchers. Check the postdoctoral experience limit, participating institute and current notice.

title: Sloan Research Fellowships — 2027
description: Supports two years of fundamental research by early career scientists in eligible fields.
eligibility: Nomination required. Candidates hold a doctorate and a qualifying tenure-track position at a U.S. or Canadian institution.

title: Beckman Young Investigator — 2027
description: Funds new instruments, methods and materials that open research directions in chemical and life sciences.
eligibility: For early career independent faculty at eligible U.S. institutions. Appointment dates and citizenship or permanent residency rules apply.

title: APS Student Grant Competition — 2027
description: Supports early costs of student research in psychological science, such as materials before data collection.
eligibility: Current APS student affiliates may apply. Only one APSSC competition entry is allowed per year.

title: Stanford HAI Seed Grants — 2026
description: Funds one-year projects that test new ideas in human-centered artificial intelligence.
eligibility: Stanford teams must follow the program’s lead PI eligibility rules. Postdocs, staff and students can participate on teams.

title: MIT Global Seed Funds — 2026–27
description: Seeds international research collaborations and can support student participation.
eligibility: MIT faculty or eligible researchers with a collaborator abroad. Each country fund has its own rules.

title: Moise Y. Safra Collaborative Research Award — 2026
description: Seeds research collaborations with academic institutions in Israel on natural and artificial intelligence.
eligibility: Qualifying Harvard Kempner investigators, faculty or research fellows with an Israeli academic collaborator.

title: Stanford King Center Global Development Initiatives — 2026–27
funder: Stanford King Center on Global Development
description: Funds Stanford teams studying global development and poverty through seed projects or multi-year initiatives.
eligibility: Lead PI must be a Stanford faculty member eligible to serve as a PI.

title: Stanford VPDoR Propel Grant — up to $7,500 (FY27)
description: Reimburses activities that strengthen a collaborative external funding proposal already ready to submit.
eligibility: PI-eligible Stanford faculty. School of Medicine applicants need a co-PI from another Stanford school.

title: Stanford VPDoR Propel Grant — $7,501–$50,000 (FY27)
description: Supports up to 12 months of work to strengthen an ambitious collaborative proposal for external funding.
eligibility: PI-eligible Stanford faculty. School of Medicine applicants need a co-PI from another Stanford school.

title: Stanford Dataset Sharing for Research — FY27
description: Supports acquisition of datasets that can be shared across Stanford research groups.
eligibility: Stanford faculty as primary applicants; confirm Stanford PI eligibility and dataset access requirements.

title: Stanford C-ShaRP Voucher Program — FY27
description: Pays for use of shared research equipment, infrastructure or facility staff time.
eligibility: PIs within their first two years at Stanford must collaborate with shared facility staff; at least one facility staff member must be a co-applicant.

title: Stanford Cancer Institute Fellowship Awards — 2027
description: Provides salary and benefits support for mentored cancer research and career development.
eligibility: Stanford postdoctoral researchers should check mentor letters and the requirement to seek additional peer-reviewed funding.

title: Stanford RAISE Health Seed Grants — 2026–27
description: Supports one year of research or education on responsible AI in medicine, including fairness and evaluation.
eligibility: Stanford affiliates need a Stanford faculty member eligible to serve as PI. Check team rules.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Identify a PI-eligible Stanford faculty member and agree which part of the project your team will lead.

title: Stanford Impact Labs: Lab Funding — 2027
description: Funds social science teams working with partners on concrete public problems. Amount and duration vary by track.
eligibility: PI-eligible Stanford faculty engaged in social science research; check partnership and track requirements.
amount: Up to $2.5 million over five years

title: Stanford King Center Global Development Research — Spring 2027
funder: Stanford King Center on Global Development
description: Supports new or early-stage studies on development and poverty in low- and middle-income countries.
eligibility: Stanford faculty and postdoctoral scholars. Check the call for postdoctoral application requirements.
amount: Up to $80,000 for faculty or $30,000 for postdocs

title: Align Technology Annual Research Awards — 2027
description: Supports one-year university research projects in orthodontics and dentistry.
eligibility: University faculty. Use the application instructions for the Americas, EMEA, or Asia-Pacific region.

title: Simons Scientific Software Research Faculty Award — 2027–28
description: Supports new research faculty positions focused on scientific software for five years.
eligibility: Applicants need a record of scientific software leadership. Awardees must take a qualifying new position at a U.S. PhD-granting institution.
amount: Salary support and $50,000 annual research allowance

title: Amazon Research Awards — On-Device Multimodal Perception (Fall 2026)
description: Supported research in multimodal perception on devices. This was a specific topic in the fall 2026 round.
eligibility: Check Amazon’s institutional and PI rules for future calls.

title: Google Carbon Removal and Superpollutant Elimination R&D Awards — 2026
description: Supported research and prototyping on carbon removal and reducing superpollutants.
eligibility: Researchers at universities, research institutions and other eligible organizations; applicable experience and community engagement requirements apply.

title: MIT J-WAFS Water and Food Seed Grant — 2027
description: Funds early-stage research addressing food and water challenges.
eligibility: MIT faculty or research staff with PI privileges. Submit a letter of interest first; full proposals are by invitation.
amount: Up to $75,000 per year for one or two years

title: Duke Cook Center Research Grants on Race, Institutions and Inequality — 2027
description: Supports pilot and planning studies on inequality in society, institutions, and health.
eligibility: Duke faculty teams should verify the call’s PI requirements. Early-career faculty participation is preferred.
amount: Up to $60,000 for pilots or $10,000 for planning

title: University of Toronto Mississauga Research Seed Grant — 2026–27
description: Funds early-stage work to strengthen a specific external grant application.
eligibility: Primary appointment at the Mississauga campus and eligibility to serve as a PI. Confirm contract and lead-applicant rules.

title: Oxford Martin School Research Programmes — 2027
description: Funds high-risk, solutions-focused research programmes across disciplines.
eligibility: Requires two or more Oxford applicants across departments, with contracts covering the project period. Start with an expression of interest.
amount: £250,000–£1 million over two to five years

title: ETH Zurich Research Grants
description: Seed funding for pioneering ETH research, with single-PI and collaborative tracks.
eligibility: PIs must be employed by ETH Zurich throughout the project. External funding and supervisory rules apply.

title: UC Berkeley Grants in Asian American Research — 2026
description: Supports research on Asian American populations and communities.
eligibility: UC Berkeley faculty, staff who conduct research, and students. Rules and budgets vary by track.
amount: Up to $5,000 for faculty and graduate students; $1,000 for undergraduates

title: NUS Artificial Intelligence Institute Seed Grant — FY2026
description: Supports AI research projects within the NUS Artificial Intelligence Institute programme.
eligibility: Check NUS faculty appointment and NAII membership requirements. The FY2026 round closed November 10.

title: UBC Grants for Catalyzing Research Clusters — 2027–28
description: Supports research networks building new collaborations across disciplines.
eligibility: Lead must be UBC Vancouver faculty eligible for Tri-Agency funds. The notice of intent was due November 2; check whether your team filed it.

eligibility_rules.required_prior_step: Check that a notice of intent was filed by November 2, 2026.

title: University of Michigan Graham Sustainability Catalyst Grants — FY2026
description: Supports short sustainability research projects with partners.
eligibility: PI-eligible University of Michigan faculty at Ann Arbor, Dearborn, or Flint. The listed round is closed.

title: Stanford Health Care Cancer Center Clinical Innovation Fund
description: Supports projects to improve cancer care delivery and patient experience.
eligibility: Projects need an eligible Cancer Service Line PI or co-PI; non-CSL researchers need a CSL collaborator.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Identify a Cancer Service Line PI or co-PI. The submission portal accepts proposals monthly.

title: Stanford AIMI–AWS Cloud Credit Program
description: Supports Stanford work in AI for health and medicine through computing credits.
eligibility: AIMI-affiliated Stanford faculty, or postdocs and trainees in an affiliated lab with mentor permission to submit.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Ask your AIMI-affiliated faculty mentor if you can submit as trainee PI.

title: Stanford AIMI–Google Cloud Credits — small proposals
description: Supports Stanford work in AI for health and medicine through computing credits.
eligibility: For eligible Stanford researchers on AI in medicine and imaging; check AIMI PI requirements. Larger proposals are paused.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Confirm AIMI PI eligibility and use the small-proposal form; larger awards are paused.

title: Stanford AIMI Trainee Travel Awards
description: Supports Stanford work in AI for health and medicine through conference travel.
eligibility: Stanford trainees presenting AI in medicine or health research; check presentation and reimbursement rules.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Confirm your trainee category, presentation format, and funding availability with AIMI.

title: Anthropic AI for Science — Research Credits
description: Provides Claude credits for scientific projects that need significant model usage. Credits are not cash.
eligibility: Researchers may apply for project credits. The separate team plan requires a qualifying institutional PI or equivalent.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Use the project-credit form, not the PI-only team-plan form. Confirm institutional terms before using any restricted data.

title: Biswas Family Foundation Fast Grants — Cycle 2
description: Funds one-year AI and data projects that advance health research, including tools and agents for scientists.
eligibility: Researchers across career stages may apply through an eligible institution; undergraduates need a faculty sponsor and can only request the lowest tier.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Confirm that the project advances health research and that your institution can accept the gift. Then choose a funding tier.

title: NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship — 2027–28
description: Supports PhD projects advancing accelerated computing. Includes a required summer internship.
eligibility: For qualifying PhD students who can complete the in-person internship. The application window for this round has closed.

title: The Company of Biologists Travelling Fellowships — February 2027
description: Helps cover expenses for a collaborative research visit to a different lab.
eligibility: Graduate students and postdoctoral researchers. Check journal scope and travel date requirements. No nationality restriction.
